fit_reason: Whole aluminum fishing boat with motor and trailer listed by a private owner in boats by owner.
findings: Leaves and debris scattered across the rear deck carpet
Dirty, stained and worn-looking carpet on the gunwales and side panels
Grime and residue on the dash and around the helm console, with old sticker remnants
Dull, water-stained aluminum on the transom and rear hull corner
Brown film and grime along the lower hull sides
Dusty, dirty seat cushions and seat covers in the cockpit
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the 1990 Lowe with the Johnson 100. The leaves on the rear deck carpet and the grime around the dash and transom are things a good cleaning would take care of before buyers come to look. We do pre-sale boat details, cleaning the carpet, seats, console and hull, and we come to you. Would you like a quote?
